title: Invertibility of the canonical mate for integral quotient reduction
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, schemes $X,Y$, a morphism $f:X\to Y$, Chern data $c_Y,c_X$ [def-sp-tower-class-chern], and intermediate coefficient pullback data $d$ [def-sp-tower-chern-pullback-intermediate]. Let $L_T\dashv U_T^D$ be the recorded derived reduction adjunctions [def-sp-tower-class-reduction], $F$ the exact inverse image of abelian towers [lem-sp-tower-integral-class-pullback], $P=d.\mathrm{pull}$, and $b:U_Y^D F^D\simeq P^D U_X^D$ the localization of $d.\mathrm{forgetIso}$. Define $\lambda:F^D L_X\to L_Y P^D$ to be the adjunction mate of $b$, characterized by $\eta_X(F^D M)\,U_X^D(\lambda_M)=F^D(\eta_Y(M))\,b_{L_Y M}$. Then $\lambda$ is invertible. No normalization of the integer or root comparisons is assumed, and no such endpoint equation is concluded. Compositions are left to right.

proof.text: The ordinary reduction unit is the cokernel of the variable-prime-power multiplication map on the power-twisted tower. Evaluate at each level and apply exact inverse image to the source cokernel. Additivity preserves prime-power multiplication. The ordinary mate, after forgetting and composing with the inverse of the forgetful-square isomorphism, commutes with these cokernel projections by the unit-mate equation. Uniqueness of cokernels makes each component invertible. The faithful exact forgetful functor reflects invertibility back to systems.

proof.text: Use the torsion-free power-system resolutions. Ordinary reduction preserves quasi-isomorphisms between regular complexes, so its resolving-class derived computation makes the supplied universal-derived counit invertible on every regular complex. Exact inverse image preserves monic prime-power multiplication, hence the same resolution computes both source and target reduction.

proof.text: Compare the specified derived mate on a cochain representative with the ordinary mate by applying the target adjunction hom equivalence. The unit-mate equation, naturality of the localized forgetful square, the localization composition factors, and the two recorded representative transpose equations identify the two composites. On a regular resolution all other factors are invertible, so the derived mate is invertible. Every derived object is isomorphic to the localization of such a resolution; naturality transports invertibility.
